content.short: Fun.xyz provides funding rails for applications to optimise onboarding and reduce costs.
content.description: Fun.xyz supplies the rails applications use to get users funded and executing on-chain actions, optimising for conversion and cost across the available routes. Monad's documentation lists it under onramps. Funding is consistently the largest drop-off point in consumer crypto products, which is why an entire vendor category has formed around this single step.
